frame: Three candidate families fixed before new coding; qualitative rival comparisons after inspecting observations. No historical likelihood or evidence-count voting.

rival_mapping.I: Imported or curated material; object/food transport control, not equivalent to parent R2
rival_mapping.R: Regional transfer/contact or moving specialists; parent R3
rival_mapping.N: Independent reconstruction under similar constraints; parent R4
rival_mapping.parent_R2_R5: Indo-Iranian inheritance and later literary synthesis require independently owned textual controls; material records do not decide them.

comparisons.feature: Hard-stone working stages and technical knowledge
comparisons.established_at_scope: Unfinished working-stage objects occur in source-qualified later assemblages; the Harappa pot also contains curated earlier objects. Bhagwanpura BPR-36 is an unfinished roughly faceted specimen in late IB, while BPR-208 requires catalogue reconciliation.

rivals.prediction: Dated successive local production should preserve linked technical choices and replacement operations.
rivals.missing: No linked intermediate waste/tool sequence, diagnostic operation order or learner succession is documented in the inspected later loci.

rivals.prediction: Curated objects or traded roughouts can enter later deposits without local manufacture of the entire product.
rivals.missing: Manufacturing dates, sourcing and associations are insufficient to separate imported roughouts from local shaping.

rivals.prediction: Local work can use techniques supplied by contact or incoming makers.
rivals.missing: No observed route distinguishes resident teaching from incoming specialists.

rivals.prediction: Common shaping and drilling solutions can be reconstructed from material constraints.
rivals.missing: Rarity and independent reconstruction of the proposed linked choices have not been measured.

narrow_control.scope: Every bead was acquired as an already completed ornament
narrow_control.reason: Unfinished specimens require an additional working-stage or collection explanation. This does not exclude transport or curation of unfinished material.

comparisons.least_supported_transition: Intermediate working-stage occurrence to continuous resident teaching, followed by a specified textual operation. No bead-technique counterpart is in the fixed text frame.
comparisons.next_test: Reconcile accessions, map unfinished objects with screened waste and tools, directly constrain contexts, and compare microscopic sequence signatures against regional and independent-production controls.

comparisons.feature: Clay preparation, forming/joining and controlled finishing/firing
comparisons.established_at_scope: Hulas preserves described joining and trimming traces; Bhagwanpura supplies pottery tools, form comparisons and a small material analysis. No inspected series has a securely dated unchanged technical recipe with a known teacher chain.

rivals.prediction: Successive working contexts should retain particular forming habits while decoration or supply changes.
rivals.missing: Phase-specific production waste, diagnostic choices and direct chronology are incomplete.

rivals.prediction: Shared pots or imported specialist products can create similarities without local transmission of their manufacture.
rivals.missing: Bulk clay similarity lacks regional geological controls; dabber function and workshop associations need verification.

rivals.prediction: Local clay preparation and shaping can be adopted through regional contact.
rivals.missing: Pottery coexistence and copied-looking shapes do not locate who taught whom.

rivals.prediction: Wheel work, joining and thermal control can converge under similar clay and vessel requirements.
rivals.missing: The documented choices are not calibrated as a rare inherited bundle.

narrow_control.scope: Vessel-shape resemblance itself identifies a transferred manufacturing recipe
narrow_control.reason: Form, raw body and forming/firing choices have separate observations and need their own joins; the comparison is a limit on a claim, not an excluded historical route.

comparisons.least_supported_transition: Shared material or form to a transmitted distinctive operation bundle and a named institution.
comparisons.next_test: Analyze paste, join orientation, forming traces, thermal signatures and production failures in dated local contexts; compare using geological controls and goal-constrained independent makers.

comparisons.feature: Plant processing, storage and ecological/seasonal management
comparisons.established_at_scope: Plant impressions and husk material, storage/grinding candidates and three direct Jognakhera crop dates establish bounded plant-use or handling endpoints. They do not recover an ordered plow–yoke–sowing–irrigation programme.

rivals.prediction: Successive households should preserve particular processing or management relations despite changed town form.
rivals.missing: A dated diagnostic processing sequence and transmission relation are absent.

rivals.prediction: Imported crop products can be stored, ground or burned locally without transferring cultivation knowledge.
rivals.missing: Crop sourcing and growing-regime evidence do not separate imported products from local cultivation in each context.

rivals.prediction: Regional exchange can move crops and methods through several routes.
rivals.missing: The movement of seed, harvested food, people and instructions is not separated.

rivals.prediction: Grinding, storage and seasonal selection can arise from recurring practical needs.
rivals.missing: Rare operation choices and competing solutions have not been assessed.

narrow_control.scope: Summer/winter legumes and grains alone demonstrate same-plot rotation or a common carrier
narrow_control.reason: Deposition can combine different fields, seasons, imports and times. The source's rotation/migration arguments exceed what those occurrences alone discriminate.

comparisons.least_supported_transition: Dated plant-use endpoints to a specific operational relation, carrier and RV10.101 counterpart.
comparisons.next_test: Recover context-specific processing fractions, residues on tools, husk-bearing construction material, crop-growing regimes and short-lived dates, with transport and formation controls.
